config.description: P4b: score simple guesses, hand-written rules and logistic regression on the P4a test cases, with weather of the last 7 to 30 days and habitat.

rules_weather.reason: Piemonte sheet for B. edulis: at least 30 mm of rain, then porcini come up 12 to 15 days later. Rain from 30 to 8 days before covers that delay and the days the flush lasts.

Piemonte sheets for B. edulis and B. aereus: fruiting needs a sudden cooling of the soil after a warm period. The sheet gives no number. 1 degree cooler over the last 7 days than over the last 30 is a stated choice, above day to day noise in a 7-day mean.
Preprint: fruiting was concentrated at a 20-day mean temperature of 10 to 15 degrees, peak near 13. 14 days is the closest window in this table.
Preprint, upper end of the 10 to 15 degree range.

rules_habitat.reason: Piemonte sheet for B. aereus: from 200 m. B. edulis starts at 300 m.
Piemonte sheet for B. edulis: up to the tree line, about 2,000 m. Acid, well-drained soil also matters, but P2 found the soil maps too uncertain to use.
